subject.title: fix(exec-approval): distinguish non-persistable command from ask=always policy in approval prompt

question: Should maintainers repair this focused PR as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97069, or promote a broader sibling PR instead?
rationale: Several open candidate PRs target the same bug, and this branch still has concrete code blockers plus a contributor proof gap, so the canonical landing path needs maintainer coordination.

options.title: Repair this PR before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open and require the embedded parser fix, native Telegram reason coverage, and real prompt proof before treating it as canonical.

options.title: Promote a sibling fix
options.body: If a sibling PR has broader, cleaner coverage and sufficient proof, preserve useful context there and close or supersede this PR only after that path is selected or merged.

recommendation.title: Repair this PR before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open and require the embedded parser fix, native Telegram reason coverage, and real prompt proof before treating it as canonical.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice centers on how one-shot approval semantics should flow through real approval renderers.
